questions.question: What is the LCM of 13, 65, and 91?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Spot common factor: all numbers contain 13

13, 65 = 5 × 13, 91 = 7 × 13

Take highest powers of all primes: 13, 5, 7

LCM = 13 × 5 × 7

**∴ Answer = 455**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers = 13, 65, 91

**Formula used:**

LCM = Product of highest powers of prime factors

**Calculation:**

⇒ 13 = 13

⇒ 65 = 5 × 13

⇒ 91 = 7 × 13

⇒ LCM = 13 × 5 × 7

⇒ LCM = 455

**∴ The correct answer is 455.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM using Prime Factorization

Break each number into prime factors and take highest powers. Example: LCM = product of max powers.

LCM of Co-prime Numbers

If numbers are co-prime, LCM = product of numbers.

Relation between HCF and LCM

For two numbers: LCM × HCF = Product of numbers

Shortcut Trick

Take common factor out first, then multiply remaining unique factors.

questions.question: By how much is 60% of 45 greater than (1)/(5) of 55?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert quickly using decimal form

60% of 45 = 0.6 × 45 = 27

1/5 of 55 = 11

Difference = 27 − 11

**∴ Answer = 16**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

60% of 45 and 1/5 of 55

**Formula used:**

x% of y = (x/100) × y

**Calculation:**

⇒ 60% of 45 = (60/100) × 45 = 27

⇒ 1/5 of 55 = 55 ÷ 5 = 11

⇒ Difference = 27 − 11 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

x% of y = (x/100) × y

Fraction to Percentage

1/5 = 20%, so 1/5 of any number = 20% of it

Quick Multiplication Trick

0.6 × 45 = (6 × 45)/10 = 27

Difference Concept

If A is greater than B, then Difference = A − B

questions.question: In a town with 75,000 voters, 95% cast their votes, all of which were valid. There were three candidates: A, B, and C. Candidate A received 40% of the valid votes, while candidate B received 12% fewer votes than A. What percentage of the valid votes did candidate C receive?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

B is 12% less than A ⇒ B = 40% − 12% of 40%

⇒ B = 40% − 4.8% = 35.2%

A + B = 40% + 35.2% = 75.2%

C = 100% − 75.2%

**∴ Answer = 24.8%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total voters = 75000

Votes cast = 95%

Votes received by A = 40%

B received 12% less votes than A

**Formula used:**

Valid votes = Total voters × Percentage ÷ 100

Votes of candidate = Percentage × Total valid votes ÷ 100

Reduced value = Original × (1 − Reduction ÷ 100)

Remaining percentage = 100 − (Sum of known percentages)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Valid votes = 75000 × 95 ÷ 100 = 71250

⇒ Votes of A = 40 × 71250 ÷ 100 = 28500

⇒ Votes of B = 28500 × (1 − 12 ÷ 100) = 28500 × 88 ÷ 100 = 25080

⇒ Votes of C = 71250 − (28500 + 25080) = 71250 − 53580 = 17670

⇒ Percentage of C = 17670 × 100 ÷ 71250 = 24.8%

**∴ The correct answer is 24.8%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Reduction

If a value is x% less than another, New = Original × (1 − x/100)

Valid Votes

Valid votes = Total voters × turnout percentage

Distribution Rule

Sum of percentages of all candidates = 100%

Shortcut Insight

Work directly in percentages to avoid large number calculations

questions.question: If P : 17 :: 42 : 6, then find the value of P.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a proportional analogy, the ratio between the terms on both sides is constant.

Observe the complete pair: 42 is exactly 7 times 6 (42 ÷ 6 = 7).

Applying the exact same multiplier to the first pair: P must be 7 times 17.

P = 17 × 7 = 119.

**∴ The correct answer is 119.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P : 17 :: 42 : 6

**Formula Used:**

In any proportion a : b :: c : d, the product of extremes equals the product of means (a × d = b × c).

 
 P : 17 :: 42 : 6 
 × 7 
 × 7 

**Calculations:**

⇒ P × 6 = 17 × 42

⇒ P = (17 × 42) ÷ 6

⇒ P = 17 × 7

⇒ P = 119

**∴ The correct answer is 119.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio and Proportion

A proportion is an equation stating that two given ratios are mathematically equivalent. In the proportion a : b :: c : d, the outer terms 'a' and 'd' are known as extremes, while the inner terms 'b' and 'c' are called means.

Product Rule of Proportion

For any valid set of proportional terms, the product of the means will always equal the product of the extremes: a × d = b × c.

Fourth Proportional

If a : b :: c : x, then x represents the fourth proportional to a, b, and c, and it is directly calculated using the formula x = (b × c) ÷ a.

questions.question: During the festive season, one large laddoo having radius 32 cm is made as prashad. After pooja, it is decided to make small laddoos from one large laddoo so as to distribute to the devotees. How many laddoos of radius 2 cm can be made?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of small spheres = (R / r)³

R = 32 cm, r = 2 cm

(32 / 2)³ = 16³

16³ = 4096

**∴ Answer = 4096**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of large laddoo = 32 cm, Radius of small laddoo = 2 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of large laddoo = (4/3) × π × 32³

⇒ Volume of small laddoo = (4/3) × π × 2³

⇒ Number of laddoos = (Volume of large) ÷ (Volume of small)

⇒ = 32³ ÷ 2³

⇒ = (32 / 2)³ = 16³

⇒ = 4096

**∴ The correct answer is 4096.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

Volume = (4/3) × π × r³

Ratio of Volumes

For spheres, volume ratio = (R / r)³

Cube Concept

a³ means a × a × a

Scaling Property

If radius increases k times, volume increases k³ times

questions.question: A person saves 10% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹360, then his income (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the total income of the person be 100%.

Given Savings = 10% → Expenditure = 100% − 10% = 90%.

We know that 90% of Income = ₹360

100% of Income = (360 ÷ 90) × 100 = ₹400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Savings percentage = 10%

Total Expenditure = ₹360

**Formula Used:**

Income = Expenditure + Savings

 
 
 
 Expenditure (90%)
 10%
 
 

 ₹360
 
 

 Savings

 

 Total Income (100%) = ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total income of the person be x.

⇒ Savings = 10% of total income = 0.10x

⇒ Expenditure = Total Income − Savings

⇒ Expenditure = x − 0.10x = 0.90x

⇒ We are given that Expenditure is equal to ₹360.

⇒ 0.90x = 360

⇒ x = (360 × 100) ÷ 90

⇒ x = 400

**∴ The correct answer is ₹400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure & Savings Relation

The most fundamental rule of personal finance math is Income = Expenditure + Savings. Any percentage given for one variable automatically establishes the remaining percentage out of 100%.

Base Calculation from Percentage

When a part of a value is given along with its corresponding percentage, the base value (100%) can always be calculated as: Base = (Given Value × 100) ÷ Percentage.

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Converting percentages to fractions drastically speeds up calculation in competitive exams. For example, saving 10% (1/10) directly implies spending the remaining 90% (9/10). If 9 units = 360, then 1 unit = 40, making the total 10 units = 400.

questions.question: The value of the expression (1.1² - 0.9²)/(0.011² - 0.009²) times 0.1² is _____.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

(1.1² − 0.9²) = (1.1 − 0.9)(1.1 + 0.9) = 0.2 × 2 = 0.4

(0.011² − 0.009²) = (0.011 − 0.009)(0.011 + 0.009) = 0.002 × 0.02 = 0.00004

Expression = (0.4 / 0.00004) × 0.01 = 10000 × 0.01

**∴ Answer = 100**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(1.1² − 0.9²) ÷ (0.011² − 0.009²) × 0.1²

**Concept Used:**

Identity: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ ((1.1 − 0.9)(1.1 + 0.9)) ÷ ((0.011 − 0.009)(0.011 + 0.009)) × 0.1²

⇒ (0.2 × 2) ÷ (0.002 × 0.02) × 0.1²

⇒ 0.4 ÷ 0.00004 × 0.1²

⇒ 10000 × 0.01

⇒ 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity: Difference of Squares

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Decimal Simplification

Convert decimals to fractions or simplify stepwise carefully

Powers Rule

a² = a × a

BODMAS Rule

Follow order: Brackets → Orders → Division → Multiplication → Addition → Subtraction

questions.question: Two trains are running in opposite directions at the same speed. If the length of each train is 444 m and they cross each other in 37 seconds, then what is the speed of each train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ Relative speed = sum of speeds

Total distance = 444 + 444 = 888 m

Relative speed = 888 ÷ 37 = 24 m/s

Each train speed = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 m/s

**∴ Answer = 12 m/s**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of each train = 444 m, Time = 37 s, Same speeds in opposite direction

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time, Relative speed = sum of speeds

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance covered = 444 + 444 = 888 m

⇒ Relative speed = 888 ÷ 37 = 24 m/s

⇒ Let speed of each train = x

⇒ Opposite direction ⇒ Relative speed = 2x

⇒ 2x = 24 ⇒ x = 12 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 12 m/s**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

Relative speed = Speed₁ + Speed₂

Train Crossing Concept

Distance = sum of lengths when trains cross each other

Unit Conversion

1 m/s = 18/5 km/h

Same Speed Case

If both speeds are equal, relative speed = 2 × individual speed

questions.question: Find the effective price percentage of the marked price after three consecutive discounts of 11%, 18% and 20% (rounded off to two decimal places).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use successive discount multiplier method

Effective price % = 100 × (1 − 0.11)(1 − 0.18)(1 − 0.20)

= 100 × 0.89 × 0.82 × 0.80

= 100 × 0.58376

**∴ Answer = 58.38%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive discounts = 11%, 18%, 20%

**Formula used:**

Final Price = Marked Price × (1 − d₁/100)(1 − d₂/100)(1 − d₃/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Marked Price = 100

⇒ After 11% discount: 100 × 0.89 = 89

⇒ After 18% discount: 89 × 0.82 = 72.98

⇒ After 20% discount: 72.98 × 0.80 = 58.384

⇒ Effective price % = 58.384% ≈ 58.38%

**∴ The correct answer is 58.38%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Net factor = (1 − d₁/100)(1 − d₂/100)(1 − d₃/100)

Equivalent Discount

Equivalent discount = 1 − net factor

Marked Price Assumption

Assume MP = 100 to directly get percentage

Multiplicative Effect

Discounts apply successively, not additively

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert to bases: 25=5², 125=5³, 4=2², 10=2×5, 6=2×3

First bracket ⇒ (5²×2−⁸) ÷ (5−²×2−¹⁵) = 5⁴×2⁷

Second bracket ⇒ simplifies to 5⁵

Whole ⇒ (5⁴×2⁷) ÷ 5⁵ = 2⁷×5−¹

**∴ Answer = 128 ÷ 5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

{ (25 × 4−⁴) ÷ (5−³ × 10 × 4−⁸) } ÷ { (3−⁵ × 10−⁵ × 125) ÷ (5−⁷ × 6−⁵) }

**Concept Used:**

Laws of indices

**Calculation:**

⇒ 25 = 5², 125 = 5³, 4 = 2², 10 = 2 × 5, 6 = 2 × 3

⇒ First bracket = (5² × 2−⁸) ÷ (5−³ × 2 × 5 × 2−¹⁶)

⇒ = (5² × 2−⁸) ÷ (5−² × 2−¹⁵)

⇒ = 5²−⁽−²⁾ × 2−⁸−⁽−¹⁵⁾ = 5⁴ × 2⁷

⇒ Second bracket = (3−⁵ × (2 × 5)−⁵ × 5³) ÷ (5−⁷ × (2 × 3)−⁵)

⇒ = (3−⁵ × 2−⁵ × 5−⁵ × 5³) ÷ (5−⁷ × 2−⁵ × 3−⁵)

⇒ = (5−²) ÷ (5−⁷) = 5⁵

⇒ Whole expression = (5⁴ × 2⁷) ÷ 5⁵

⇒ = 2⁷ × 5−¹ = 128 ÷ 5

**∴ The correct answer is 128/5**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Laws of Indices

am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ, (am)ⁿ = amⁿ

Negative Powers

a−ⁿ = 1 / aⁿ

Convert numbers into primes for easy cancellation

questions.question: A man bought some oranges at the rate of 10 for ₹ 300 and sold them at the rate of 5 for ₹ 175. What is his profit percentage (correct to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find per orange price directly

CP per orange = 300 ÷ 10 = 30

SP per orange = 175 ÷ 5 = 35

Profit per orange = 35 − 30 = 5

**∴ Profit % = (5/30) × 100 = 16.67%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost: 10 oranges = ₹300, Selling: 5 oranges = ₹175

**Formula used:**

Profit % = [(SP − CP) / CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP per orange = 300 ÷ 10 = 30

⇒ SP per orange = 175 ÷ 5 = 35

⇒ Profit per orange = 35 − 30 = 5

⇒ Profit % = (5 / 30) × 100

⇒ = 16.666...% ≈ 16.67%

**∴ The correct answer is 16.67%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

Profit % = [(SP − CP) / CP] × 100

Unitary Method

Convert group prices into per unit price for easy comparison

Quick Trick

Compare per item instead of total quantities

Rounding Rule

Round off to two decimal places as required

questions.question: In triangle ABC , BD perp AC at D and angle DBC = 66^circ . E is a point on BC such that angle CAE = 35^circ . What is the measure of angle AEB ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ In right-angled ΔBDC, ∠C = 90° − ∠DBC = 90° − 66° = 24°.

⇒ Since E lies on the line segment BC, ∠AEB acts as the exterior angle to ΔAEC at vertex E.

⇒ By the exterior angle theorem, ∠AEB = ∠CAE + ∠C.

⇒ ∠AEB = 35° + 24° = 59°.

**∴ The correct answer is 59°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ In ΔABC, BD ⊥ AC at D.

⇒ ∠DBC = 66°

⇒ E is a point on BC such that ∠CAE = 35°

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Sum of interior angles of a triangle = 180°

⇒ Exterior angle theorem: Exterior angle = Sum of the two opposite interior angles

questions.question: X, Y and Z together can complete a piece of work in 8 days, while X alone can complete it in 24 days and Y alone can complete it in 36 days. Find in how many days Z alone can complete the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take total work = LCM(8, 24, 36) = 72 units

Efficiency of (X + Y + Z) = 72 ÷ 8 = 9 units/day

Efficiency of X = 72 ÷ 24 = 3 units/day

Efficiency of Y = 72 ÷ 36 = 2 units/day

Efficiency of Z = 9 − (3 + 2) = 4 units/day

**∴ Answer = 72 ÷ 4 = 18 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

X + Y + Z can complete work in 8 days

X alone = 24 days, Y alone = 36 days

**Formula used:**

Total Work = LCM of time

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Efficiency of (X + Y + Z) = 9 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of X + Y = 3 + 2 = 5 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of Z = 9 − 5 = 4 units/day

⇒ Time taken by Z alone = 72 ÷ 4 = 18 days

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

Assume total work as LCM of given times to simplify efficiency calculation

Efficiency Concept

Efficiency = Work done per unit time

Combined Work

Total efficiency = sum of individual efficiencies

Inverse Relation

questions.question: A dealer marks his goods at 25% above the cost price and allows a discount of 28% on the marked price. What is his gain or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let CP = 100

MP = 125 (25% increase)

SP = 125 × (1 − 0.28) = 125 × 0.72 = 90

Loss = 100 − 90 = 10

**∴ Loss % = 10%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked price = 25% above cost price, Discount = 28%

**Formula used:**

MP = CP × (1 + 25/100)

SP = MP × (1 − 28/100)

Profit/Loss % = [(SP − CP) / CP] × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let CP = 100

⇒ MP = 100 × 1.25 = 125

⇒ SP = 125 × 0.72 = 90

⇒ Loss = 100 − 90 = 10

⇒ Loss % = (10 / 100) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10% loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price Concept

Marked Price = Cost Price + Markup

Discount Formula

SP = MP × (1 − Discount%)

Profit/Loss Formula

Profit/Loss % = [(SP − CP) / CP] × 100

Successive Percentage

Markup and discount are applied successively, not directly subtracted

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4,000 at 6% per annum rate of interest for the period from 22 February 2024 to 23 April 2024.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a leap year (2024), total days = 366.

Days from 22 Feb to 23 Apr = 7 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 23 (Apr) = 61 days.

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

SI = (4000 × 6 × 61) ÷ (100 × 366)

SI = 240 × (1 ÷ 6) = 40

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4000

Rate (R) = 6% per annum

Time period = 22 February 2024 to 23 April 2024

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
• 
 22 Feb 2024 P = ₹4000 23 Apr 2024 SI = ₹40 Rate = 6% p.a. Time = 61 days 2024 is a Leap Year = 366 days 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Year 2024 is exactly divisible by 4, so it is a leap year with 366 days.

⇒ February in a leap year has 29 days.

⇒ Number of days in February (excluding 22nd) = 29 − 22 = 7 days.

⇒ Number of days in March = 31 days.

⇒ Number of days in April (up to 23rd) = 23 days.

⇒ Total Time (T) = 7 + 31 + 23 = 61 days.

⇒ Time converted into years = 61 ÷ 366 = 1 ÷ 6 year.

⇒ SI = (4000 × 6 × 1) ÷ (100 × 6)

⇒ SI = 24000 ÷ 600 = 40

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Counting Days for Interest

Generally, the day the money is deposited is not counted, but the day it is withdrawn is included in the total interest calculation.

Leap Year Calculation

A year is considered a leap year if it is perfectly divisible by 4 (and by 400 if it is a century year). Simple Interest calculations must use 366 days as the base denominator for a leap year unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Simple vs Compound Interest

In Simple Interest, the principal amount remains constant throughout the entire period. In Compound Interest, interest gets periodically added to the principal and earns further interest.

questions.question: The difference between the present ages of two sisters is 3 years. After 2 years, the elder sister will be twice as old as the younger sister was 2 years ago. Find the sum of their ages after 8 years from now.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let younger = x, elder = x + 3

After 2 years: elder = x + 5

Younger 2 years ago = x − 2

Condition: x + 5 = 2(x − 2) ⇒ x = 9

**∴ Sum after 8 years = (9+8) + (12+8) = 17 + 20 = 37**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference of ages = 3 years

Condition: After 2 years, elder = 2 × (younger 2 years ago)

**Formula used:**

Let present ages be x and x + 3

**Calculation:**

⇒ Younger = x, Elder = x + 3

⇒ Elder after 2 years = x + 5

⇒ Younger 2 years ago = x − 2

⇒ Equation: x + 5 = 2(x − 2)

⇒ x + 5 = 2x − 4

⇒ x = 9

⇒ Younger = 9, Elder = 12

⇒ After 8 years: 17 and 20

⇒ Sum = 17 + 20 = 37

**∴ The correct answer is 37 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Rule

Difference of ages remains constant over time

Equation Formation

Translate word conditions into algebraic equations

Time Shift Concept

Future age = Present + years, Past age = Present − years

Sum of Ages

Add individual ages after applying time change

questions.question: The ratio of three numbers is 12 : 21 : 5. If 50 percent of the first number is 78, then what would be 50 percent of the absolute difference of third and second number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

50% of first = 78 ⇒ first = 156

Ratio 12 : 21 : 5 ⇒ 12 parts = 156 ⇒ 1 part = 13

Second = 21 × 13 = 273, Third = 5 × 13 = 65

Difference = |273 − 65| = 208

**∴ Answer = 50% of 208 = 104**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio = 12 : 21 : 5, 50% of first number = 78

**Formula used:**

If ratio is a : b : c, numbers = ax, bx, cx

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let numbers = 12x, 21x, 5x

⇒ 50% of first = 78 ⇒ 0.5 × 12x = 78

⇒ 6x = 78 ⇒ x = 13

⇒ Numbers = 156, 273, 65

⇒ Difference (second − third) = 273 − 65 = 208

⇒ Required = 50% of 208 = 104

**∴ The correct answer is 104.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

Absolute Difference
